name: source_corrections_read
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
L=Path.cwd()
for n in ['tidor','alon','saturation']:
 r=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout',str(L/'sources'/f'{n}.pdf'),'-'],capture_output=True,text=True);assert r.returncode==0;s=r.stdout
 w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(L/'write_lane.py'),f'sources/{n}.txt'],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True);assert w.returncode==0
 print('BODY',n,'LENGTH',len(s));print(s[:19000] if n=='tidor' else s[:15000] if n=='alon' else s[:12000])
